name: TC-PM-002 — 迭代状态机10种状态流转验证 [P1]
description: 验证迭代10种状态的正确流转路径和非法流转拦截

steps.expression: (() => { const statusText = document.body.innerText; const expectedSteps = ['买手下 Brief', '产运确认', '试拍', '试拍审核', 'Leader 复核', '视觉归档']; const foundSteps = expectedSteps.filter(e => statusText.includes(e)); const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-tabs-tab')).map(t => t.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean); return { foundSteps, allStepsFound: foundSteps.length === expectedSteps.length, tabs }; })()

(() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const bottomActions = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b => { const rect = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.top > window.innerHeight - 100; }).map(b => b.textContent.trim()); return { bottomActions }; })()
steps.description: 检查底部操作栏当前可用action

_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 验证状态步骤条展示6步
2. 各状态下验证底部操作栏展示正确action
3. 验证非当前处理角色只读
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 步骤条展示：买手下Brief→产运确认→试拍→试拍审核→Leader复核→视觉归档
2. DRAFT_BRIEF底部：保存草稿、提交Brief
3. PENDING_BRIEF底部：确认Brief、驳回Brief
4. IN_PRODUCTION底部：保存草稿、发起评审
5. ARCHIVED/CANCELLED无主流程action
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/权限与状态机
